correctness.rationale: For H_n on Z/n with edges {i,i+1,i+3}, n>=7, two lean colors force all triples monochromatic and hence the connected graph constant, impossible. Three-color lean edge means c_i+c_(i+1)+c_(i+3)=0 over F3. Kernel dimension of 1+t+t^3 on Z/(t^n−1) equals degree gcd; 1+t+t^3=(t−1)(t²+t+2) and roots of irreducible quadratic have exact order 8. Thus 3 solutions (all constant) unless 8|n, when 27 solutions and exactly 24 nonconstant named minima, all 8-periodic with two monochromatic triples per period. Explicit valid 4-color block words of sizes 4,9,10,11 (shared prefix 012 and boundary-compatible suffix) concatenate to every n>=8. At n=7 the edges form Fano STS, each repeated-color class must contain a complete line, and two Fano lines intersect, so nonconstant coloring needs >=5 colors; a line plus four distinct colors gives exactly 7·5·4!=840. Independently checked all q<=5 n=7 colorings, three-color recurrence n8..23 and explicit 4-color words n8..300. Infinite proof algebraic and constructive, not inferred from finite checks.
residual_risks: Finite tests cannot prove all-parameter claim; proof reconstruction establishes stated scope.

Fox tricoloring equivalence with F3 linear equations is also classical, not newly claimed.
